Thanks — a few HR/compensation points and attachments (CompBands_2026_Q2.pdf & comp-band-chart.png):

- Confirmed L5 band (US, Bay Area adjusted): $165,000 — $215,000 base. Your proposed $205k is within range.
- Equity: typical grant for L5 is $150k target value (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff) — we can adjust if you prefer to front-load or increase sign-on instead.
- Probation: we standardize on a 90-day introductory period language. HR recommends: "The employee will have a 90-day introductory period during which performance will be reviewed; continuation of employment is subject to satisfactory performance and business needs." Avoid explicit "probation terminates employment" wording to stay consistent with employment law guidance.
- Relocation: can be conditional. Recommend "up to $8,000 reimbursement upon submission of receipts and proof of permanent residence within 60 days of start."
- Background & visa: include standard contingency clause: "Offer contingent upon successful completion of background check and eligibility to work in the U.S." If candidate needs visa sponsorship, we need to loop Legal — none indicated in Michael's note.
- Headcount/funding: Please submit headcount approval request to Finance with the comp package. If Finance approval takes longer than 48 hours, we can issue an approval-to-offer (ATO) with the condition that the offer is contingent on final budget sign-off; however, ATOs complicate negotiation.

I'll attach the updated comp band PDF for record. Once we have Finance's OK, HR will prepare the final DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations, Redwood Inference
